description:
About our brand and products

We’re Steve & Joan — the husband-and-wife team behind Scuvvers, based on Australia’s Sunshine Coast. What started as a simple idea at our kitchen table — protecting our car seats from surf sessions, muddy mountain bike rides, gym sweat and camping chaos — has grown into a global community of adventurers spanning 36 countries.

Scuvvers are seat covers, reinvented. They’re made for people who hate seat covers — premium, sustainable, stowable protectors you deploy when life gets messy and stow away when it's not. Each Scuvver is built from 100% recycled textile (around 35 plastic bottles per cover), 10× stronger than neoprene, and PFAS-free, offering waterproof protection without the toxic chemicals.

What makes us different

We’ve turned one of the world’s most boring product categories into something people actually want. Scuvvers are not permanently-on covers — they’re smart, convenient, and stylish, designed for people who live active, adventurous, and sometimes downright messy lives.

  • Sustainably made, designed to last years, not months.

  • Always ready when you need them, stowed away when you don’t.

  • Loved by everyone from tradies and triathletes to surfers, campers, mountain bikers and parents.

  • Featured by Pinkbike as one of their Favourite Products of 2024.

We’re a small Aussie brand doing our bit for the planet — turning recycled bottles into something useful, practical, and built for all the mud, salt and chaos that make life better.

How affiliates can earn

Our creators and affiliates earn commission on every sale they refer through their unique link or discount code — no cap, no tricks. We value genuine relationships, not quick posts, so we love building long-term collaborations where creators share Scuvvers naturally within their lifestyle.

We also run special promotions, campaigns and giveaways throughout the year that give our partners extra opportunities to earn and engage their audiences.

How to promote us

We encourage affiliates to show Scuvvers in action — after a surf, training session, trail ride, or workday on site. Authentic, lived-in content always performs best.
Ideas include:

  • Before/after shots showing how quick it is to deploy and stow.

  • Reels or TikToks of real-life use (mud, sand, sweat, kids, pets, gear).

  • Honest, first-hand reviews and lifestyle posts showing Scuvvers as part of your everyday routine.

We provide image and video assets if needed, but most partners prefer to create their own real-world content that fits their audience’s vibe.

Other information

  • Markets: Australia, USA, Canada, New Zealand, Europe, Japan.

  • Retail partners: Autobarn, Backcountry, MEC Canada, Sport Import EU, Fukaya Japan.

  • Eco commitment: Every Scuvver saves ~35 bottles from landfill and uses solution-dyed fabric that reduces CO₂ by 92%.

  • Support: We’re hands-on founders — affiliates can reach us directly for product info, creative ideas, or campaign support.

We’re not looking for perfection — we’re looking for real. If your audience loves getting outside (and occasionally filthy), we’d love to work with you.
